mechanism: Turmeric (curcumin) inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2C9, potentially reducing tamoxifen metabolism and increasing its active metabolite endoxifen formation, while also possessing antiplatelet properties that may increase bleeding risk.
action: Monitor for increased tamoxifen side effects and bleeding symptoms; consider spacing administration or consulting oncology before concurrent use, particularly in patients on concurrent anticoagulants.
